name: WPA Journal Watch Editorial Intelligence Policy
purpose: Detect, classify and structure source-traceable topic candidates and editorial briefs for human scholarly review without automatically generating, accepting, peer-reviewing or publishing scientific articles.
boundary: Journal Watch may prepare editorial intelligence. It has no authority to convert a signal, topic candidate or editorial brief into an accepted or published scientific article.
human_gate: Any scientific article, editorial acceptance decision, peer-review decision, issue assignment or publication action requires the applicable human editorial process and Human Gate.
non_claims: Topic detection is not peer review.
An editorial brief is not a scientific article.
Source prominence is not evidence of scientific quality.
Journal Watch output is not an acceptance decision.
Journal Watch output is not an endorsement of a source or institution.
